Here's where it stands, Zachary. The NerdQaxe++ was delivered August 19, and your return under ···· (USPS (number hidden)) still hasn't reached our Chattanooga warehouse.

The Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 is still unshipped and out of stock with no date, and that's far too long. The B.04 swap you picked is priced higher than the $10 you were quoted, so I've pushed the team to honour that quote rather than charge you the difference.

Stay in the chat and one of them will pick it up here.
Do I need to send the power supply unit back with the BSB Nerdqaxe++?

No, just the miner itself. Keep your power supply, the fault is on the board and the return is logged for the NerdQaxe++ unit only.

Pack it securely, write Shop···· clearly on the outside of the box, and drop it with USPS using the label you have ((number hidden)). We'll email you once it's checked in at our Chattanooga warehouse.
Would there be any other alternative for a replacement instead of the BC04
Used the order-swap skill

Yes. Three I can offer you for a US address:

Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s, $379, in stock, ships within 2 business days.
Magic Miner 40T, $799, not in stock today, it's a pre-order that ships by Dec 14, 2026.
Harlo B30, 30 TH/s, $899, not in stock today, it's a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026.

Each costs more than the $119.30 on your Bitaxe line, so there'd be a difference to settle. Tell me which one interests you and I'll price it to the cent before anything changes.
I want something that I would not have to split the difference.
Used the order-swap skill

Straight answer: nothing in stock matches 4.2 TH/s at the $119.30 you paid.

The only no-cost swaps are a step down. The J. Miner BTC Solo Lite, 1.2 TH/s, $99, in stock, ships within 2 business days, and $20.30 comes back to you. The L. Miner LV08, same 4.2 TH/s as your Bitaxe, in stock, would be $87.90 more.

The B.04 at the $10 you were quoted is still with the team, who pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET. Want me to hold off until they confirm that?
The Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 is valued at 229$. Even if it was part of a bundle I should receive equal value, should I not?

That's a fair point, and I'm not going to argue it. The swap prices off what the line actually took on the order, $119.30, so crediting the full $229 isn't mine to grant.

That's exactly what I put to the team: honour the BC04 at the $10 you were quoted, which is the $229 value you're describing. They pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email, so you don't need to wait here.

Nothing changes on the order until you say so.
They tried to offer me the 40TH tower miner and it is outside my price range.

Understood, I've noted that: the 40T is out of your range and you're not looking to pay a difference on either unit.

So it stays as it is. The Bitaxe line stays open for the BC04 at the $10 quote, and your NerdQaxe++ RMA runs on its own once the unit reaches Chattanooga. No top-up on either from my side.

The team picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET and you'll get their answer by email.
